outcome: Electrical activity of pelvic floor muscles (PFM)
Positive electrical activity percentage of PFM
cohort: Term pregnant women divided into oxytocin infusion and control (spontaneous labour) groups.
finding: During physiological labour, pelvic floor muscles (PFM) exhibited a relatively silent status, while oxytocin administration resulted in a more contractile PFM status during uterine contractions, and multiparous women showed more positive electrical activity traces than nulliparous women.
mod_finding: The rate of performed episiotomies was significantly higher in the oxytocin-infused labours.
